performance.reason: Raw traces require separate performance analysis

useful_flops_identity.method: DCE differentiated JAXPR of the original logical model, with spatial and temporal rematerialization disabled; 2MNK per live dot; scan multiplicity included

previous_failure.error: RuntimeError('The FLOPs counter ended before all 12 horizons were counted',)

useful_flops_continuation.reason: Previous CPU counter stalled in kernel mode and was stopped; its cause is unconfirmed. Continue with process-local THP disabled and an exact recount.

checks: all forward/training GEMM records and primitive counts

slowdown_investigation.scope: Read-only investigation of the active BW training slowdown; GPU run continues; final MFU remains deferred

timing_comparison.scope: Diagnostic timing comparison of the same first 26 completed updates; not MFU or final performance acceptance

slowdown_investigation.conclusion: The sampled preparation delay is dominated by GPU-driver host-page pinning entering synchronous transparent-hugepage compaction. This identifies the current bottleneck, not a complete attribution of every historical timing difference.
limitations: Historical and current physical GPUs differ (3 versus 2).
No controlled old/new execution or THP-policy A/B has been performed.
The second CPU capture timed out reading one userspace map; its kernel call chain is resolved.
Two short CPU profiles were collected during this run; BW performance already has a monitoring-gap qualification.
slowdown_investigation.next_validation: Test process-scoped THP disabling before worker initialization in a separate short run; measure allocation, compute, and numerical equivalence before adopting it.

process_thp_capability_probe.scope: Capability-only probe in a separate CPU process; no training process or global policy changed

thp_comparison.scope: Same GPU, same checkpoint and updates29..30; sequential runs, not a randomized experiment

checkpoint_values.scope: CPU comparison; finite values, exact tree/dtypes/counters; relative L2 <= 1e-5 for parameters and optimizer

scope: Actual complete trajectories and extracted evidence; large raw captures and checkpoints remain at their recorded source locations
